title: Section G: Schema Validation Verification
description: Validates strict Pydantic/JSON schema typing, cross-field logical consistency, regex formatting, and failure injection detection.

assertions.name: Type_And_Required_Field_Compliance
assertions.message: Schema validator enforced required field existence and type constraints.

assertions.name: Regex_Format_Constraint_Validation
assertions.message: Regex formatting rules validated for invoice IDs, emails, and ISO dates.

assertions.name: Cross_Field_Logical_Consistency_Validation
assertions.message: Cross-field mathematical equality (Subtotal+Tax=Total) and chronological ordering verified.

assertions.name: Failure_Injection_Anomaly_Detection
assertions.message: Caught and rejected all 3 injected schema anomalies (bad types, negative amounts, missing keys).
